Conas a Oibríonn

Sreafaí oibre oibríochta

Léiríonn na sreafaí oibre seo a leanas conas a oibríonn an córas i gcomhthéacsanna oibríochta coitianta laistigh de sheirbhísí cúraim rialáilte.

Gach gníomh taifeadta

Cruthaíonn gach iontráil úsáideora rian iniúchta inleanúna.

Sreafaí oibre struchtúrtha

Ní ligeann foirmeacha do chéimeanna a chailleadh nó sonraí éigeantacha a fhágáil ar lár.

Iniúchtaí ag am ar bith

Is féidir le cigirí rochtain a fháil ar thaifid chomhlíonta ag aon phointe.

Rólbhunaithe

Tá rochtain ar fheidhmeanna nasctha le róil úsáideora atá sainmhínithe ag an tseirbhís.

Sruth Oibre

Ionanálú Cónaitheora

An seicheamh ó atreorú go dtí críochnú ionanálaithe — ag clúdach measúnachta, toilithe, doiciméadú riosca, agus leithdháileadh aonaid.

  1. 1

    Atreorú faighte

    Administrator

    Referral documented with source, presenting need, and initial eligibility assessment.

    System: Referral record created and assigned to admissions coordinator.

  2. 2

    Measúnú réamh-iontrála

    Clinician

    Clinical assessment completed and recorded against the referral. Outcome and recommendation documented.

    System: Assessment form attached to referral. Status updated to Assessment Complete.

  3. 3

    Lonnú deimhnithe

    Manager

    Placement decision approved. Unit and room assigned. Admission date set.

    System: Resident record created. Unit occupancy updated. Admission date confirmed.

  4. 4

    Foirmeacha iontrála críochnaithe

    Key Worker

    All required admission documentation completed and signed — consent, care agreement, personal profile.

    System: Admission forms marked complete. Care programme initialised.

  5. 5

    Plean cúraim tosaigh gníomhachtaithe

    Clinician

    Initial care plan drafted, reviewed with resident, and formally activated.

    System: Care programme status set to Active. First review date scheduled automatically.

Sruth Oibre

Tuairisciú Teagmhas

Conas a thaifeadtar, a chatagóraítear, a ardaítear, a athbhreithnítear agus a dhúntar teagmhais laistigh den chóras.

  1. 1

    Teagmhas tuairiscithe

    Key Worker

    Staff member records the incident immediately or as soon as practicable after the event.

    System: Incident record created with timestamp. Notifications dispatched to designated persons.

  2. 2

    Duine ainmnithe ag admháil

    Manager

    Person in charge reviews and formally acknowledges the incident report.

    System: Acknowledgement logged. Escalation flag set if severity threshold met.

  3. 3

    Imscrúdú sannta

    Manager

    Investigation assigned to the appropriate person with expected completion date.

    System: Investigation record created and linked to incident. Due date reminder scheduled.

  4. 4

    Torthaí agus gníomhaíochtaí taifeadta

    Auditor

    Investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective actions documented with assigned owners.

    System: Corrective actions created with assigned owner and due dates. Overdue alerts configured.

  5. 5

    Teagmhas dúnta go foirmiúil

    Manager

    All corrective actions verified complete. Incident record closed with sign-off.

    System: Incident status set to Closed. Full record locked. Audit trail preserved.

Sruth Oibre

Próiseas Iniúchta

Sreafaí oibre iniúchta inmheánacha agus seachtracha — ó ullmhúchán go dtí giniúint tuairisce agus rianú plean gníomhaíochta.

  1. 1

    Iniúchadh sceidealaithe

    Manager

    Audit defined with type, scope, target date, assigned auditor, and regulatory framework reference.

    System: Audit record created. Auditor notified. Checklist generated from audit type template.

  2. 2

    Iniúchadh á sheoladh

    Auditor

    Auditor works through checklist items, attaches evidence, and records observations against each standard.

    System: Checklist progress tracked in real time. Incomplete items flagged before submission.

  3. 3

    Torthaí taifeadta

    Auditor

    Non-conformances, observations, and positive findings recorded with severity classification.

    System: Finding records created. Corrective actions auto-generated for non-conformances.

  4. 4

    Gníomhaíochtaí ceartaithí réitithe

    Manager

    Actions assigned to responsible parties completed and verified. Evidence of resolution attached.

    System: Action status updated to Resolved. Verification logged.

  5. 5

    Iniúchadh dúnta

    Manager

    Audit formally closed with sign-off. Full audit trail retained for inspection.

    System: Audit status set to Closed. Record locked. Available in regulatory report exports.
